mapper.sql: id, kb_id, source_type, client_request_id, request_hash, status, total_count, success_count, failure_count, running_count, created_by, updated_by, created_at, updated_at, finished_at

id, task_id, kb_id, asset_id, file_name, file_hash, source_url, parse_attempt, docling_request_id, docling_job_id, source_revision, stage, status, progress, dedupe_strategy, dedupe_result, duplicate_asset_id, error_code, error_message, created_at, updated_at, finished_at
mapper.select:
select
from ingestion_task order by created_at desc, id desc limit #{limit}

select
from ingestion_task_item where task_id = #{taskId} order by created_at asc, id asc

select iti.id, iti.task_id, iti.kb_id, iti.asset_id, iti.file_name, iti.file_hash, iti.source_url, iti.parse_attempt, iti.docling_request_id, iti.docling_job_id, iti.source_revision, iti.stage, iti.status, iti.progress, iti.dedupe_strategy, iti.dedupe_result, iti.duplicate_asset_id, iti.error_code, iti.error_message, iti.created_at, iti.updated_at, iti.finished_at from ingestion_task_item iti inner join ingestion_task it on it.id = iti.task_id where it.kb_id = #{kbId} and it.id = #{taskId} and iti.status = 'FAILED' order by iti.created_at asc, iti.id asc

select iti.id, iti.task_id, iti.kb_id, iti.asset_id, iti.file_name, iti.file_hash, iti.source_url, iti.parse_attempt, iti.docling_request_id, iti.docling_job_id, iti.source_revision, iti.stage, iti.status, iti.progress, iti.dedupe_strategy, iti.dedupe_result, iti.duplicate_asset_id, iti.error_code, iti.error_message, iti.created_at, iti.updated_at, iti.finished_at from ingestion_task_item iti inner join ingestion_task it on it.id = iti.task_id where it.kb_id = #{kbId} and it.id = #{taskId} and iti.id = #{itemId}
mapper.update: update ingestion_task_item iti inner join ingestion_task it on it.id = iti.task_id set iti.stage = 'UPLOAD', iti.status = 'PENDING', iti.progress = 0, iti.docling_request_id = #{nextDoclingRequestId}, iti.parse_attempt = #{nextParseAttempt}, iti.docling_job_id = null, iti.error_code = null, iti.error_message = null, iti.updated_at = #{updatedAt}, iti.finished_at = null where it.kb_id = #{kbId} and it.id = #{taskId} and iti.id = #{itemId} and iti.status = 'FAILED' and iti.parse_attempt = #{expectedParseAttempt}

update ingestion_task_item iti inner join ingestion_task it on it.id = iti.task_id set iti.stage = #{stage}, iti.status = 'RUNNING', iti.progress = #{progress}, iti.error_code = null, iti.error_message = null, iti.updated_at = #{updatedAt}, iti.finished_at = null where it.kb_id = #{kbId} and it.id = #{taskId} and iti.id = #{itemId}

update ingestion_task it join ( select task_id, count(1) as total_count, sum(case when status in ('SUCCESS', 'SKIPPED') then 1 else 0 end) as success_count, sum(case when status = 'FAILED' then 1 else 0 end) as failure_count, sum(case when status = 'RUNNING' then 1 else 0 end) as running_count, sum(case when status = 'PENDING' then 1 else 0 end) as pending_count from ingestion_task_item where task_id = #{taskId} group by task_id ) s on it.id = s.task_id set it.total_count = s.total_count, it.success_count = s.success_count, it.failure_count = s.failure_count, it.running_count = s.running_count, it.status = case when s.running_count > 0 then 'RUNNING' when s.pending_count > 0 then 'PENDING' when s.failure_count = s.total_count then 'FAILED' when s.success_count = s.total_count then 'SUCCESS' else 'PARTIAL_SUCCESS' end, it.updated_by = #{updatedBy}, it.updated_at = #{updatedAt}, it.finished_at = case when s.running_count + s.pending_count > 0 then null else #{updatedAt} end where it.kb_id = #{kbId}
